title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p6n9: lichen_tdma_init header/implementation signature mismatch
description: The header in link.h (line 335) declares lichen_tdma_init with signature `(struct lichen_tdma_ctx *, const struct lichen_link_ctx *)` but the implementation in link_ctx.c (line 586) still uses the old signature `(struct lichen_tdma_slot *)`. The structs are incompatible (different members, different sizes: tdma_slot has {id, assigned, next}, tdma_ctx has {superframe, slot, n_slots, slot_duration, synced}). This is a build-breaking mismatch introduced by this commit.
